'''Renaad''' was a [[Gender|male]] villager from the [[planet]] [[Vuundalla]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. He had a daughter named [[Mina]]. Renaad, Mina and their fellow villagers were subjects of [[King]] [[Pychor Vuundir]] and [[Queen]] [[Dafne Vuundir]], who cared little for their subjects' welfare. After Renaad's village was devastated by a [[groundquake]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Zia Zaldor Zanna]] and [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]] and [[Nubs]] came to the aid of the villagers and offered to get supplies. While Pychor and Dafne were unwilling to help, the Jedi younglings managed to convince [[Prince]] [[Cyrus Vuundir]] to gather supplies to help the villagers rebuild their village. As a result, Cyrus got to know his subjects including Renaad and Mina, winning their respect.<ref name="Aftershock" />

Later, Renaad and Mina were present when Cyrus gave his Jedi friends Brightstar, Solay and Nubs a tour of their village, which was undergoing rebuilding. Renaad explained that the village's herd of [[fathier]]s had taken a liking to Cyrus due to his regular visits. Shortly later, the [[Comet Runners]] pirate gang raided the village and stole the fathiers. Cyrus and the Jedi embarked on a mission to rescue the fathiers. After Cyrus assumed his pirate alter ego [[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr Val Dorn]] and defeated the Comet Runners, the Jedi returned the fathiers to the villagers. Renaad thanked Cyrus for helping them while Mina offered to teach him to ride a fathier.<ref name="The Prince of Masks">{{YJA|The Prince of Masks}}</ref>
